default.description: The channel's value before any node writes it.

reducer.description: How an update combines with the current value. Defaults to `overwrite`.

CheckpointDefinition.description: Where a workflow keeps its checkpoints.

path.description: For `sqlite`: the database file, relative to the workflow file.

oneOf.description: In process memory: a thread resumes only in the process that paused it.
No checkpoints: a workflow with interrupts cannot use this.

Condition.description:
A condition over state: a comparison (`field`, `op`, `value`), or `all`, `any` or `not` of
conditions. There is no free-form expression: a condition is data, never code.

field.description: A dotted state path, such as `review.approved`.

not.description: Holds when the condition does not.

value.description: The value to compare with: a string, number or boolean, or a list for `in`.

oneOf.description: Equal; numbers compare numerically, booleans as `true`/`false`.
A string contains the value, or a list holds it.
A string starts with the value.
A string ends with the value.
A regular expression matches; `(?i)` makes it case-insensitive.
The value is one of a list.
The value is absent, null, or empty.

anyOf.description: Consecutive node ids, each connected to the next.

EdgeDefinition.description:
An edge item: a chain of node ids, or an edge object.

A chain `[START, a, b, END]` adds an edge between each consecutive pair.

EdgeSpec.description: One edge from a node. Exactly one of `to`, `routes` and `switch` is set.

cases.description: For `switch`: the node for each value, compared as text after trimming.

default.description: For `routes` and `switch`: the node when nothing matches. Defaults to `END`.

routes.description: Conditional routes, tried in order; the first whose `when` holds is taken.

switch.description: A state path whose value selects the next node from `cases`.

to.description: Always continue to these nodes; more than one runs them in parallel.

message.description: What the run asks; a template over state.

response_schema.description: A JSON Schema the answer must satisfy; checked when the run resumes.

LlmDefinition.description: An LLM agent declared in the workflow.

description.description: What the agent does, for its description.

instruction.description: The agent's instruction. `{key}` placeholders read session state, as in any `LlmAgent`.

model.description:
A model alias from `models`, a registered model name, or a `provider/model` reference
such as `anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5`.

tools.description: Registered tools the agent may call, by name.

NodeDefinition.description: One node. Exactly one of `agent`, `llm`, `function`, `set`, `action` and `interrupt` is set.

action.description:
Runs an `adk-action` action node (`type: http`, `transform`, `switch`, ...). Its
`id`, `name`, error handling, tracing and output mapping default from the node.

agent.description: Runs a registered agent, by name.

function.description: Runs a registered function node, by name.

input.description:
For `agent` and `llm` nodes: a template for the message the agent receives. Defaults to
the last message in `messages`, else `input`.

interrupt.description: Pauses the run for an answer, which a resume supplies.

llm.description: Runs an LLM agent declared here.

max_attempts.description: Attempts for a node that fails, including the first. Defaults to 1.

output_key.description:
The state key the node writes: an agent's final text, an interrupt's answer, or an
action's result. Agent nodes also append their text to `messages`.

set.description: Writes state keys. A string value is a template: `{{key}}` and `{{key.field}}` read state.

ReducerKind.description: How a channel combines an update with its current value.

oneOf.description: The update is appended; a list update appends each item.
The update is added to a number.

to.description: The node the route goes to, or `END`.

Targets.description: One node id, or a list of them.

description: A graph workflow that adk-graph compiles into a graph: nodes, edges with conditional routes, state channels, interrupts and checkpointing.

checkpoint.description: Where checkpoints are kept. Defaults to memory.

edges.description: The edges, in order. `START` and `END` name the graph's entry and exit.

interrupt_after.description: Nodes the run pauses after; resuming the thread continues past them.

interrupt_before.description: Nodes the run pauses before; resuming the thread runs the node.

models.description: Model aliases: a name an `llm` node can use in place of a `provider/model` reference.

name.description: Workflow name; a graph agent built from it takes this name.

recursion_limit.description: The most supersteps one run may take. Defaults to the graph's limit, 100.

state.description:
State channels that need a reducer or a default. A key no channel names is overwritten
by each update. `messages`, which agent nodes append to, appends unless declared here.
